{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "71ba1b28",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# 认识"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "6e0d07d9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "from astroquery.nist import Nist\n",
    "import astropy.units as u\n",
    "from astropy.table import Table\n",
    "from astropy.io import fits\n",
    "from astroquery.mast import Observations\n",
    "from cos_functions import estimate_snr\n",
    "\n",
    "fonts = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'SimSun', 'sans-serif']\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = fonts\n",
    "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\", font=fonts)\n",
    "# 设置全局高清显示（放在代码最前面）\n",
    "plt.rcParams['figure.dpi'] = 150  # 屏幕显示清晰度\n",
    "plt.rcParams['savefig.dpi'] = 300 # 保存图片的清晰度\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4515c253",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 物质波长"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1ab2f57c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "以氢原子为例， 我们可以看看在300到700nm波段中，他的一些波长"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "aea67b96",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "table = Nist.query(300 * u.nm, 1500 * u.nm, linename=\"H I\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "740ade32",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "- `observed` 实验室实际测得波长\n",
    "- `Ritz` 理论波长\n",
    "- `Rel.` 相对光强。波长概率"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "143b08c2",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "['Observed', 'Ritz', 'Transition', 'Rel.', 'Aki', 'fik', 'Acc.', 'Ei           Ek', 'Lower level', 'Upper level', 'gi   gk', 'Type', 'TP', 'Line']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print(table.colnames)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 32,
   "id": "74df9155",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def get_element_data(element_name=\"H I\"):\n",
    "    \"\"\" 获取物质的波长和光强. 300-700nm \"\"\"\n",
    "    table = Nist.query(300 * u.nm, 700 * u.nm, linename=element_name)\n",
    "    df = table.to_pandas()\n",
    "    \n",
    "    result_df = pd.DataFrame()\n",
    "    \n",
    "    result_df['Wavelength'] = df['Observed'].fillna(df['Ritz'])\n",
    "\n",
    "    def clean_rel(val):\n",
    "        s = str(val).strip()\n",
    "        nums = \"\".join([c for c in s if c.isdigit() or c == '.'])\n",
    "        try:\n",
    "            return float(nums) if nums else 0.0\n",
    "        except:\n",
    "            return 0.0\n",
    "            \n",
    "    result_df['Intensity'] = df['Rel.'].apply(clean_rel)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    result_df['Element'] = element_name\n",
    "    return result_df\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 51,
   "id": "94dbe03e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "elements = ['O III', 'H I', 'CA II', 'He I', 'Na I', 'Mg I']\n",
    "dfs = [get_element_data(ele)  for ele in elements]\n",
    "df = pd.concat(dfs)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 54,
   "id": "44a367c2",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1800x1500 with 6 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "colors = sns.color_palette(\"rocket\", len(elements))\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 10), sharex=True) \n",
    "axes_flat = axes.flatten()\n",
    "\n",
    "for i, name in enumerate(elements):\n",
    "    ax = axes_flat[i]\n",
    "    subset = df[df['Element'] == name]\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 1. 绘制谱线\n",
    "    ax.vlines(subset['Wavelength'], 0, subset['Intensity'], \n",
    "              colors=colors[i], linewidth=1.5)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # 2. 找到最强峰值并标注 (Peak Picking)\n",
    "    if not subset.empty:\n",
    "        # 获取最强线的数据点\n",
    "        peak = subset.loc[subset['Intensity'].idxmax()]\n",
    "        peak_w = peak['Wavelength']\n",
    "        peak_i = peak['Intensity']\n",
    "        \n",
    "        # 在峰值上方添加文字标注\n",
    "        ax.annotate(f'{peak_w:.1f} nm', \n",
    "                    xy=(peak_w, peak_i), \n",
    "                    xytext=(0, 5),          # 向上偏移 5 个点\n",
    "                    textcoords='offset points',\n",
    "                    ha='center',            # 水平居中\n",
    "                    va='bottom',            # 垂直底部对齐\n",
    "                    fontsize=9,\n",
    "                    fontweight='bold',\n",
    "                    color=colors[i])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 3. 样式设置\n",
    "    ax.set_title(f\"Element: {name}\", fontsize=12, color=colors[i], fontweight='bold')\n",
    "    ax.set_ylim(0, subset['Intensity'].max() * 1.3) # 增加高度比例(1.3)给文字留空间\n",
    "    ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "bfb3afce",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": []
  },
